FOUR! Good length, outside off again. Khan advances down the pitch and skies a poor drive for four runs over the off side.
FOUR! On a good length, pitching outside off stump again. Carty rocks back and punches a drive for 4 runs through the off side.
Length ball, pitching outside off again. Khan advances and lofts a mediocre drive for a single run down the ground.
SIX MORE! Free hit. Pitched up, outside off stump once more. Khan gets on the back foot and drives for six runs over the off side.

commentary.label: 8nb
commentary.commentary: SIX! No ball. Full toss, pitching outside off. Khan gets forward and skies a pull for six runs.
Good line and length from van Schalkwyk. Khan gets forward and defends shakily
Good length, pitching outside off. Khan advances down the pitch but misses while trying to play a drive
On a good line and length. Carty gets on the front foot and finesses a glance down the ground for a run.
On a good line and length from Forde. Khan pushes forward and flicks a glance for a couple of runs behind square.
FOUR! Forde pitches one up, outside off. Khan moves onto the front foot and eases a drive for 4 runs.

commentary.label: 6lb
commentary.commentary: Short of a length, pitching on a good line. Carty gets on the back foot, and is hit on the pad while trying a pull behind square, resulting in three leg byes. The ball is misfielded by Pooran costing three runs.
Forde now coming over the wicket. Forde pitches one up, on line. Khan advances and plays a flick for one run.

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Forde breaks through! Back of a length, pitching outside off. Ayub advances down the pitch and edges, and is caught by Pienaar back behind point.
Length ball, outside off stump. Ayub gets forward and eases a poor drive on the off side.
Short of a length, on a good line. Ayub goes back and inside edges for 1 run back behind square.

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! van Schalkwyk breaks through! Good length, pitching outside off stump once more. McKenzie gets on the back foot and skies a shaky drive, and is caught by Bishop on the off side.
Good length, outside off. Carty moves onto the back foot and flicks a glance for a run behind point.
Back of a length from van Schalkwyk, pitching outside off. Carty pushes forward and plays a poor pull
On a good length, outside off stump. Carty gets on the back foot and drives on the off side.
On a good length, outside off. McKenzie moves onto the back foot and slices a square cut for a run.
